landing.signInFailed: Sign-in didn't go through — try again.
landing.heroTitle: Know the rule before the whistle.
landing.heroSubtitle: OfficialIQ turns the rulebook into ten minutes a day. Weekly quizzes on the articles your association is covering, spaced repetition on the calls you miss, and a full exam simulator before certification.
landing.heroCtaSub: Sign in securely with Internet Identity — no password, no email required.
landing.featuresSubtitle: The schedule follows your association's rules calendar, so what you study is what you'll be tested and evaluated on.

monday.title: The weekly quiz drops
monday.desc: Ten questions on this week's articles, each timed. Every answer reveals the rule citation and how the rest of your association answered it.

midweek.title: Misses come back
midweek.desc: Anything you got wrong returns on a spacing schedule until you hold it at 80% mastery. Weak articles surface on the progress screen with the gap named.

gameNight.title: A pregame brief
gameNight.desc: Your crew, your position and the three situations most likely to come up in this matchup. Audio mode plays it on the drive.

landing.examTitle: Walk into certification having already taken it.
landing.examDesc: A hundred questions under the real clock, drawn from the same article weighting as the state exam. You get a score breakdown by article and a study plan for whatever fell short.
landing.associationsTitle: See who is ready before you assign the game.
landing.associationsDesc: Publish your rules calendar once and every official on your roster gets it. The coordinator view shows participation, mastery by article and certification status, so assignments and training conversations start from the same numbers.

rookie.desc: The weekly quiz, your streak and progress by article. Everything you need to keep up with your association's calendar.

varsity.desc: Adds the exam simulator, spaced repetition drills, video clip review, pregame briefs and audio mode for the commute.

association.desc: Roster-wide licences, your own rules calendar, coordinator analytics and certification reporting for the state office.

landing.ctaTitle: The season starts in six weeks. Start this week.
